title: Quill — Handwriting Synthesizer
description: Type anything and watch it become real handwriting — five pens, four papers, live write-on playback, and PNG export.
concept: A procedural handwriting engine: every character is drawn individually to canvas with seeded per-glyph jitter, rotation, scale, and baseline wobble so the same text never looks robotically uniform. Five pens (ballpoint, fountain, marker, pencil, chalk) each carry their own stroke width, ink bleed, blend mode, and grain texture, layered over four paper styles (blank, ruled, grid, aged). A replay button re-inks the page character-by-character like real handwriting.
features: 5 distinct pen styles with unique ink bleed, blend mode, and grain rendering
4 paper textures (blank, ruled, grid, aged/foxed) with hand-tuned line and grid overlays
Tunable slant, jitter, baseline wobble, letter spacing and size sliders
Write-on replay animation that re-inks the page stroke by stroke
Seeded RNG reroll for a fresh 'handwriting personality' on demand
PNG export of the finished page
Save/load a library of notes to localStorage with a Notes drawer
Shareable URL-hash links that restore the exact text, pen, paper and settings

interaction.mouse: Type in the input bar; drag sliders in the pen & paper panel to reshape the ink
interaction.click: Tap pen/paper chips to switch styles; Replay to watch it write itself; Export to download PNG
interaction.touch: Full touch support — tap chips, drag sliders, tap notes drawer, native mobile keyboard for text entry
interaction.keyboard: Type directly into the textarea; standard text editing shortcuts apply
